memberships.cancelledNote: Cancelled: it is no longer renewed.
memberships.paymentsOff: The Budgets and payments app is off: fees are recorded without a payment.

fee.noPlans: No active plans. Create them in Settings → Apps → Patients → Membership plans.
fee.planArchived: This membership's plan is archived: change plan before recording the fee.
fee.enrollHint: The first fee is recorded as a payment of the patient and the membership is in force from the start date.
fee.renewHint: The fee extends cover from the last paid day. If it lapsed more than a week ago, it starts again on the payment date.

changePlan.title: Change plan
changePlan.hint: The change applies from the next fee; paid ones keep their plan.
changePlan.noOther: There is no other active plan.

cancel.title: Cancel the membership?
cancel.hint: It stops renewing. Benefits last until {date}, the last paid day.

plans.title: Membership plans
plans.intro: What the clinic offers for a monthly or yearly fee: included services and discounts on treatments.
plans.formDescription: Fees already paid keep the terms they were collected on.
plans.name: Name
plans.generalDiscountHint: On treatments without a benefit of their own.
plans.benefitsHint: Included: how many per membership year, at no cost. Discount: its own percentage instead of the general one.
plans.noCatalogue: The treatment catalogue is unavailable: no treatments can be added to the plan.
plans.frozenNote: Editing the plan does not change fees already paid.
